recommended_branches.name: 非权威边界
recommended_branches.rationale: Final assessment must prove memory does not override runtime facts.

recommended_branches.name: 持久化可靠性
recommended_branches.rationale: The first requested memory property is durable persistence.

recommended_branches.name: 审计与失效
recommended_branches.rationale: The second requested property is auditable and invalidatable memory.

recommended_branches.name: 检索正确性
recommended_branches.rationale: The third requested property is searchable and scope-safe retrieval.

recommended_branches.name: 时序图事实
recommended_branches.rationale: The follow-up graph database must preserve scoped temporal facts.

recommended_branches.name: 图查询与 Schema
recommended_branches.rationale: Graph database needs query, audit, and schema evidence.

recommended_branches.name: Pipeline 集成
recommended_branches.rationale: End-to-end rendering must write memory and graph after validation.

recommended_branches.name: 验证与 QA 证据
recommended_branches.rationale: Final acceptance requires commands, failure attribution, and two-hour evidence.

classification.summary: GROUP-6 classification separates independently gradable dimensions for validation_and_final_assessment.
